fact: The 9th RAPDP conference opened in Abidjan on 18 May 2026 with the new ARTCI regulatory council, which acts as the data protection authority, appointed on 21 April 2026, sworn in on 7 May and installed on 11 May 2026, under president Roger Félix Adom.
title: À Abidjan, l'Afrique prend date pour se doter enfin d'une vision commune sur la protection des données personnelles
